refnamediv.refpurpose: Insert a node into the child list of another node

refsynopsisdiv.programlisting: bool SilikoNodeInsert( SilikoNode *object, size_t position, SilikoNode *new_child);

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoNodeInsert function inserts new_child into the child list of object at position. SilikoNodeInsert will fail if object is not a branch node, if new_child is NULL or if position is past the end of the child list. object takes ownership of new_child and will deallocate it when object is passed to SilikoNodeDestroy or to an assign function as the destination object.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoNodeInsert returns true if it succeeded, or false if it failed.
